layout_sources: https://github.com/siddhantgoel/beancount-dkb (beancount_dkb/extractors/ec.py V2Extractor: the 12 quoted header names, utf-8-sig, %d.%m.%y, the "Girokonto";"<IBAN>" row; tests/test_ec_v2.py: the four rows above the header, "Kontostand vom <date>:", amounts "-8,67" and "-1.450" (whole euros written without decimals, a regression test since v1.4.0); CHANGELOG: BOM, "€" instead of "EUR" in the balance, both , and ; as separators)
https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/blob/main/de/dkb/README.md (new files start with the account row, "", "Kontostand vom 16.02.2024:";"100,00 EUR", ""; semicolon; d.m.y)
https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/master/bank2ynab.conf [DE Deutsche Kreditbank checking new] (file name <dd-mm-yyyy>_Umsatzliste_<Kontoname>_DE<20 digits>, Header Rows = 5, %d.%m.%y)
notes: Export from the banking introduced in 2023: UTF-8 with a BOM, every field double-quoted, four rows above the header (account name and IBAN, "", "Kontostand vom <date>:" with the balance in euros, ""), dates dd.mm.yy, Status "Gebucht", the payer and the payee in two columns (the other side is the payee for "Ausgang" and the payer for "Eingang"), a signed "Betrag (€)" in German number format where whole euros drop the decimals ("-1.150" is minus one thousand one hundred and fifty euros). Semicolons are the form in most reports (DKB has also sent commas since 2024). LF line ends and newest-first order assumed. Closing = the Kontostand row (the balance on the export day, after the newest line); no opening.
